context: This criteria evaluates the configuration of HTTPS requests with custom certificates for mutual TLS authentication, including CA, client certificates, keys, and PFX bundles.

checklist.name: Certificate Authority
checklist.description: Correctly configures custom CA certificate using the ca method for server certificate verification

checklist.name: Client certificate and key
checklist.description: Properly sets client certificate and private key using the cert and key methods for mutual TLS

checklist.name: PFX/PKCS12 support
checklist.description: Demonstrates ability to use PFX format certificates with the pfx method, including passphrase support
